runs.command:
cd "$PWD" && python3 /tmp/addtest.py src/test/java/ledger/LedgerCliTest.java <<'EOF'
  @Test
  void balancePrintsAccountTotalsAsAnIndentedTree(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
    Path file =
        journal(
            dir,
            "book.journal",
            """
            2026-01-04 Salary
              assets:bank:checking   100.00 USD
              income:salary         -100.00 USD

            2026-01-05 Grocer
              expenses:food           12.50 USD
              assets:cash            -12.50 USD
            """);

    int status = run("balance", file.toString());

    assertEquals(
"""
           87.50 USD  assets
          100.00 USD    bank
          100.00 USD      checking
          -12.50 USD    cash
           12.50 USD  expenses
           12.50 USD    food
         -100.00 USD  income
         -100.00 USD    salary
""",
        stdout());
    assertEquals(0, status);
  }
EOF
~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|expected" | head -4

cd "$PWD" && python3 /tmp/addtest.py src/test/java/ledger/LedgerCliTest.java <<'EOF'
  @Test
  void balanceDepthLimitsTheTreeToRolledUpParents(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
    Path file =
        journal(
            dir,
            "book.journal",
            """
            2026-01-04 Salary
              assets:bank:checking   100.00 USD
              income:salary         -100.00 USD

            2026-01-05 Grocer
              expenses:food           12.50 USD
              assets:cash            -12.50 USD
            """);

    int status = run("balance", file.toString(), "--depth", "2");

    assertEquals(
"""
           87.50 USD  assets
          100.00 USD    bank
          -12.50 USD    cash
           12.50 USD  expenses
           12.50 USD    food
         -100.00 USD  income
         -100.00 USD    salary
""",
        stdout());
    assertEquals(0, status);
  }
EOF
~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|expected" | head -3

cd "$PWD" && python3 /tmp/addtest.py src/test/java/ledger/LedgerCliTest.java <<'EOF'
  @Test
  void registerListsEveryPostingInFileOrder(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
    Path file =
        journal(
            dir,
            "book.journal",
            """
            2026-01-04 Salary
              assets:bank:checking   100.00 USD
              income:salary         -100.00 USD

            2026-01-05 Grocer
              expenses:food           12.50 USD
              assets:cash            -12.50 USD
            """);

    int status = run("register", file.toString());

    assertEquals(
"""
2026-01-04  Salary                assets:bank:checking            100.00 USD

""",
        stdout());
    assertEquals(0, status);
  }

~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|expected" | head -3

cd "$PWD" && python3 /tmp/addtest.py src/test/java/ledger/LedgerCliTest.java <<'EOF'
  @Test
  void registerSinceAndUntilBoundTheDateRangeInclusively(@TempDir Path dir) throws IOException {
    Path file =
        journal(
            dir,
            "book.journal",
            """
            2026-01-04 Early
              a   1.00 USD
              b  -1.00 USD

            2026-01-05 Middle
              a   2.00 USD
              b  -2.00 USD

            2026-01-06 Late
              a   3.00 USD
              b  -3.00 USD
            """);

    int status =
        run("register", file.toString(), "--since", "2026-01-05", "--until", "2026-01-05");

    assertEquals(
"""
2026-01-05  Middle                a                                  2.00 USD
2026-01-05  Middle                b                                 -2.00 USD
""",
        stdout());
    assertEquals(0, status);
  }
EOF
~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|expected:" | head -3
cd "$PWD" && ~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -A3 "but was" | head -8

cd "$PWD" && python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/test/java/ledger/LedgerCliTest.java'

s=s.replace('a                                  2.00 USD','a                                 2.00 USD')
s=s.replace('b                                 -2.00 USD','b                                -2.00 USD')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|but was" | head -3; echo "EXIT:$?"

cd "$PWD" && python3 /tmp/addtest.py src/test/java/ledger/JournalParseTest.java <<'EOF'
  @Test
  void rejectsAPostingWhoseAmountIsOnlyOneSpaceFromTheAccount() {
    Journal journal =
        Journal.parse(
            """
            2026-01-11 Sloppy
              a   1.00 USD
              b -3.00 USD
            """);

    assertEquals(
        List.of(
            new LedgerError(
                "<input>",
                3,
                "separate the account from its amount with two spaces: b -3.00 USD")),
        journal.errors());
  }
EOF
~/.local/bin/mvn -q -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run:|but was" | head -3
cd "$PWD" && ~/.local/bin/mvn -o -q clean test 2>&1 | tail -5; echo "BUILD_EXIT=$?"; ~/.local/bin/mvn -o test 2>&1 | grep -E "Tests run: .*Failures"; git status --short
cd "$PWD" && ~/.local/bin/mvn -q clean verify 2>&1 | grep -E "ERROR|Tests run" | head -5; echo "EXIT=$?"; ls target/*.jar
